column6: NCT06570798 is 'A Phase 2 Master Protocol Assessing Inebilizumab and Blinatumomab in Autoimmune Diseases'. Its two conditions, Systemic Lupus Erythematosus and Active Refractory Rheumatoid Arthritis, belong to different subprotocols and different drugs: Subprotocol A gives inebilizumab in SLE with lupus nephritis, and Subprotocol C, the only rheumatoid arthritis arm, gives blinatumomab. Inebilizumab never reaches a rheumatoid arthritis patient in this study. The registry lists both drugs and both conditions at study level with nothing joining them, which is how the pair was derived. Checked against the registry record on 2026-10-27; an API query on intervention=inebilizumab returns 32 studies and this is the only one naming rheumatoid arthritis, so the pair rests on this protocol alone. The SLE pair is left standing, because inebilizumab genuinely is the SLE subprotocol's drug.
